successors.text: Sam'al round Zincirli Hoyuk in Gaziantep Province, 'near the Nur Mountains' in the Anti-Taurus (infobox coordinates 37 06 13 N, 36 40 43 E); a 40 km circle is the researcher's reading of a 'middle…

ledger.x: By 920 BC: Sam'al is a kingdom.
825 BC: Assyria brings Sam'al under its sway.
717 BC: Sargon II ends the kingdom.
717 BC: the kingdom of Sam'al falls.

wars.name: Assyrian submission of Sam'al and Denyen
wars.outcome: 'Assyrians won over Denyen and Sam'al in 825 BC'; Shalmaneser III listed Ya'udi as a satellite.

wars.name: Sargon II's occupation of Sam'al
wars.outcome: 'At the end, in 717 BC, Assyria occupied the country under the rule of Sargon II'.

certainty.note: The page gives only the capital's coordinates and 'near the Nur Mountains'; no frontier.
